content:
**The Slasher: Out of the Shadows** is a main quest in *Fallout 76*. It will be implemented in the upcoming fall 2026 update. It is the third of four quests associated with The Slasher, a cycle of limited-time seasonal content.

This quest is only available for a limited-time, when The Slasher seasonal content is active. It is associated with "Phase 3" of the seasonal content, as tracked by The Slasher overarching side quest.

Out of the Shadows is started automatically once it is enabled as part of Phase 3 of The Slasher, unless the previous quests, Masked Truth and Secrets to the Grave, have not yet been completed. The previous two quests must be completed in order to advance to Out of the Shadows, regardless of The Slasher's phase-based progression. The first objective of the quest is to investigate two locations where the Pint-Sized Phantoms have been spotted.

The two locations are Gauley Mine and the RobCo Research Center; they can be investigated in any order. At the RobCo Research Center, enter the instanced interior and go to the research wing. Hostile robots and Pint-Sized Phantoms will be present. Head east to the executive's office on the second floor, and retrieve a note, one of the Phantoms' orders, from a military trunk.

At Gauley Mine, enter the instanced interior, which will be populated by Pint-Sized Phantoms, mole rats, and Scorched. Go to the large cavern near the Gauley Mine exit. A steamer trunk at the highest level of the cavern contains a Phantoms' orders note.

There are two Phantoms' orders notes; although the locations can be investigated in any order, the quest will place "Phantoms' orders: stay focused" in the player's inventory first (at whichever location is chosen first), followed by "Phantoms' orders: his vessel." The second note contains a mention of Organ Cave.

Investigate Organ Cave; it can be entered using any of its directional map marker entrances. The cultists who normally occupy the location will be replaced with Pint-Sized Phantoms, including a legendary, power armor-clad Pint-Sized Phantom Tinkerer. This boss enemy must be defeated as part of the quest.

Once the tinkerer is killed, on their corpse is another Phantoms' orders note ("Preserve our victory") and a holotape, The Summoning. Listening to this holotape completes the quest.
